'''Qi'us Dnar''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Qi'us Dnar first appeared in the [[2022]] Game Update 7.0 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', as part of the Galactic Seasons 2 event.<ref name="Season 2">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220215|text=Galactic Seasons 2: 'Shadows of the Underworld'}}</ref>
